note: ALARMING — this one is backwards and needs rewriting before it misleads someone. The first half is on the cited page; the second half ('allergies can be discussed at reservation') is the opposite of what the house says. Dontsuki Hidari REFUSES bookings from guests with pronounced food allergies, states its kitchen handles many ingredients so trace carry-over into a dish cannot be ruled out even when an ingredient is removed from the menu, and says its chefs have no medical knowledge and can do nothing if a reaction occurs. The one genuine nuance the record got right: /info/63.html says 「ご要望（料金、料理内容、アレルギー）は前日までにお電話にて対応可能です」 — requests can be raised by phone the day before, but only within the limits set by /info/47.html. Re-word to: allergy guests are asked NOT to book; contamination is admitted; staff decline responsibility.

Fujiiya publishes per-item 原材料 and アレルギー for its whole range, and at least two lines carry no wheat at all — 花虎白 is declared 「アレルギー：不使用」 (sugar + fruit + agar) and 淡雪花 declares gelatin only. Drop 'the entire product line'; keep 'no allergen-segregated preparation is documented', which is true (no contamination statement exists anywhere). See the paired tier_recommendation.

quote: Momiji manju are made fresh on-site and the shop emphasizes no preservatives and carefully selected ingredients.
found: Nothing on the cited page says any of this. It says only 「藤い屋のもみじ饅頭は、北海道産のこしあんとつぶあん、ふっくらと焼き上げるカステラにこだわったもみじ饅頭です。」 The nearest real support, on Fujiiya's own shop, is 「近隣の農場から新鮮な卵を仕入れ」「小麦粉は … 専用に製粉してもらった独自のものを使用」「職人が型に刷毛で油を塗りながら焼いていきます」 — plus an 原材料 list (砂糖、卵、小豆、小麦粉、水飴／乳化剤、膨張剤) that contains no preservative.
http: cited page 200; www.fujiiya.co.jp 403 on every route including Wayback; www.fujiiya-coconca.shop 200
method: plain fetch; Yahoo search for 保存料不使用 + 厳選; COCONCA shop item pages
note: Three sub-claims, none on the cited page. 'Carefully selected ingredients' is real and citable (Fujiiya's own wording: bespoke-milled flour and eggs from neighbouring farms; the maker's product page also reads 「小麦、小豆、卵といった3つの素材は、特に厳選されたものを使用しています」). 'Made fresh on-site' is only third-party (焼きたてもみじ饅頭 at the 宮島本店) and the packaged goods carry a 12-day 日保ち, so it needs qualifying to the shopfront. 'The shop emphasizes no preservatives' could NOT be found anywhere — Fujiiya never makes that claim; the most that is true is that 保存料 does not appear in the ingredient list. Delete the 'emphasizes' framing or restate it as an observation about the ingredient list. Trading status: open, 8:30–18:00, 不定休.

why: Fujiiya publishes a complete 原材料 list and an explicit アレルギー line for every product, and at least two of its lines declare no wheat at all — 花虎白 is 「原材料：砂糖、フランボワーズ／マンゴ／西洋梨、寒天」 with 「アレルギー：不使用」, and 淡雪花 declares 「アレルギー：ゼラチン」 only. A blanket 'no' tells a celiac there is nothing here, which the maker's own labelling contradicts. 'ask' is the honest tier: real wheat-free items exist and are labelled, but Fujiiya publishes no cross-contamination or segregation statement and the main line is wheat castella, so a celiac must still confirm handling in store.

花虎白 is sugar, fruit purée and 寒天 (agar, seaweed) with 「アレルギー：不使用」 — plant-only, per the maker's own declaration, and named on the record's cited page as part of the Miyajima lineup. Everything else is animal-containing and should stay flagged: momiji manju is 卵・小麦 castella, 淡雪花 is set with ゼラチン, and 杓子せんべい and the sablés carry egg, butter and dairy. One documented plant-only item in an otherwise animal-heavy range is 'limited', not 'no'.
